preflight.objective: Perform a directed OWASP-oriented security review of Desarrollo covering authentication, authorization/tenant isolation, headers/proxy trust, rate limits, secrets/configuration, dependencies, uploads and public APIs; repair any proven P0/P1 same-run.
observedControls: JWT bearer validates issuer, audience, lifetime and signing key; configured secret must be at least 32 bytes and cannot contain CHANGE_ME.
Login is anonymous by design and has a named fixed-window rate limit; failed and successful login events are audited.
CORS requires an explicit non-empty origin list.
Security headers include X-Content-Type-Options=nosniff, X-Frame-Options=DENY, Referrer-Policy=no-referrer and restrictive Permissions-Policy.
Swagger is disabled by default outside Development unless explicitly enabled.
Repository appsettings contains placeholders rather than deploy secrets.
directedRisksToVerify: ForwardedHeaders clears known proxies/networks while login rate limiting keys on RemoteIpAddress; verify the hosting proxy cannot allow client spoofing of the effective source IP used by rate limiting.
Enumerate all AllowAnonymous/public token routes and verify only intended data is reachable with bounded token lifetime/access controls.
Verify tenant/RBAC horizontal/vertical access on sensitive finance/inventario/admin endpoints.
Verify upload/import endpoints enforce size/type/content parsing limits and cannot cause path traversal, formula/script injection, resource exhaustion or cross-tenant writes.
Run dependency vulnerability scans for .NET and frontend package graph; version age alone is not a finding.
Verify no committed credentials/secrets and no secret values appear in logs/errors/evidence.
acceptance: P0=0 and P1=0 after same-run recovery.
Authentication bypass, tenant isolation and privilege-escalation negative tests pass.
Login rate limiting remains effective through the real reverse-proxy header path.
Security headers/CORS behave as configured on the deployed Desarrollo API.
Public endpoints/tokens are intentionally scoped and abuse-bounded.
Uploads/imports reject unsafe or oversized input and preserve tenant scope.
Dependency vulnerability scan has no unresolved high/critical causal exposure, or any such exposure is repaired and retested.
preflight.rollback: N8.11.A is evidence-only. Any later security hardening must be minimal, independently reversible and pass functional regression gates before receipt.
preflight.testStrategy: Use source-directed review plus targeted backend/frontend tests and deployed Desarrollo probes where authorized. Prefer negative authz/tenant tests, rate-limit/header tests, upload malformed/boundary cases, anonymous-route contract tests, and dotnet/npm vulnerability scanning. Do not weaken controls to make tests pass.
